name: Badge
summary: A small static count or status label attached to something: unread 3, Beta, Draft.
useWhen: A count of new or unread items on a nav item, a tab or a button
A short status of a row or a card: Draft, Live, Failed
Marking a feature as Beta or New
avoidWhen: The label can be pressed, toggled or removed
A sentence or a message of more than three words
The only sign of an error on a field

children.description: The visible label: Beta, Draft. One to three words.

count.description: A number shown in place of the label. Over max it shows max+ and assistive tech reads the full number.

max.description: The largest count shown in full.

countLabel.description: (count) => words read for the count: 3 unread messages. Default the number alone.

emphasis.description: solid for an unread count, soft for a status, outline for the quietest marker.

size.description: About 20 px (sm) and 16 px (xs) tall at default density; the height follows the space tokens, so it moves a pixel or two with viewport and density. A badge is not a control, so there is no md; the default md rule of anatomy.md applies to controls.

start.description: Leading content, drawn in the icon part: a system icon name or an Icon node, hidden from assistive tech. Not drawn in the dot form. Named start by rule 6 of anatomy.md; the part keeps the order's name icon.

dot.description: Draws only a dot in the solid tone. The label or count words stay for assistive tech.

a11y.role: none: a span read as text where it sits.
a11y.focus: Not focusable. It is part of the name of the control it sits in (a Button end part, a link).
a11y.announce: The label, or the count words (the full number, not 99+), as part of the surrounding text or control name.
notes: Over max, the visible max+ is aria-hidden and the full number is visually hidden text (WCAG 1.3.1).
Color is never the only signal: every badge has text, and the dot form keeps its words for assistive tech. Write the status in text next to a dot for sighted users (WCAG 1.4.1).
Text on its fill holds 4.5:1 in every tone and emphasis, checked by axe in every style and scheme (WCAG 1.4.3).
A badge inside a Button joins the button name: Open inbox 3 unread messages.

en.label: One to three words in sentence case, a noun or an adjective: Beta, Draft, Pending review.
en.countLabel: The number and what it counts: 3 unread messages.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: تجريبي، مسودة، بانتظار المراجعة.
ar.countLabel: With the Arabic plural, Western digits: رسالتين غير مقروءتين، 3 رسائل غير مقروءة، 12 رسالة غير مقروءة.

react.note: Motion (badge-count, order 1.22): when the count changes after the first paint its digits roll (digit-roll primitive) and the badge pops (scale.anticipate, scale.pop); a count is always drawn aria-hidden with a visually hidden copy; a dot only pops. Nothing under reduced motion but a fade of the digits.

styles.studio: A bold pill on the overlay and tone tints, the same tones as Button.
styles.desk: The same; the accent solid badge is yellow with ink text.
styles.neutral: Planned: follows the tokens, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A Badge with onClick as a filter
count={120} with a visible 120 in a tight nav item
A red dot as the only sign of an error
mistakes.right: A dot with words, or Alert

mistakes.wrong: A badge that says Beta feature available now
